decisionBasis: Approved fail-closed implementation discretion; no new authentication permission
reason: An unparseable Cache-Control list cannot establish that persistence restrictions are absent. Reject reuse and persistence rather than retain a document whose no-store or private directive might have been lost by all-or-nothing parsing.
scope: Malformed Cache-Control directive-list syntax only. Invalid Date, Age or numeric freshness values retain their existing separate expectations.
replacementRule: A successfully validated new key set still invalidates older cached evidence even when the new response cannot be persisted. Malformed JWKS is not successful replacement evidence.
authenticationEffect: No additional verified outcome is permitted. This amendment does not define current-invocation use of non-reusable evidence.
